facts.fact: Amnesty International names the Cyber Security and Crime Act 2021 as the law under which Hawa Hunt is prosecuted.
Hawa Hunt was arrested on 22 December 2024 and charged with two counts of transmitting insulting messages via a computer system under the Cybersecurity and Crime Act 2021.

facts.fact: TV personality Hawa Hunt was arrested on 22 December 2024 and held over a month, charged with insulting the President and First Lady in a social media video, per Amnesty International.
